liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cryptical Envelopement** (2 reviews): The Cryptical, Other One, Me and My Uncle, Other One segment is singled out as especially rockin'; The Cryptical, Drums, Other One, Uncle, Other One sequence aired on the GD Hour as an example of songs melting together, discussed by Phil with David Gans [7][12]
- **The Other One** (1 review, 1 other source): The call-and-answer exchanges during The Other One are singled out as remarkable; The Other One includes a WRS tease, which the uploader highlights [5][8]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Rub**: rare: 12 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd71-12-01.aud.minches-vernon.24765.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 123 min; rated 2.71/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds distant with barely audible vocals; the reviewer found it awful; Audience recording has clear vocals and music, in the reviewer's view better than some soundboards; Audience recording is a bit distant, but conveys the experience of being there [9][11][13][15]
- **gd71-12-01.set2-sbd.lai.3898.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 62 min; rated 4.75/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Generally excellent sound with good stereo definition; the source is not a complete show; Keith is clearly present in the mix rather than washed out; Keith comes through well, but Bob's rhythm guitar is hard to pick out [6][7][17]
- **gd1971-12-01.partial-set2-matrix.vernon.83164.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 8 songs; 44 min; rated 4.11/5 by 18 [5]. Said about its sound: Mix starts audience-heavy, with soundboard raised to resemble a good front-of-board position on the Phil side [5]
- **gd1971-12-01.sbd-set2.miller.32304.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 66 min; rated 5/5 by 12 [2]

## Around the show

- At the start of Not Fade Away, a fan can be heard exclaiming in awe [13]
- The crowd is energetic and claps in time, though the reviewer still dislikes the sound [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-12-01.aud.minches-vernon.24765.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [1]. Also: Source is an unknown audience tape via David Minor; likely lineage runs AUDMC, C, C, CDR, EAC, pitch correction, SHN; David Minches did the pitch correction and general fixing up, with minor help from Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd71-12-01.set2-sbd.lai.3898.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1971-12-01.partial-set2-matrix.vernon.83164.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Matt Vernon; source: Matrix - see info file [5]. Also: Partial set 2 matrix: audience tape speed-adjusted to match the soundboard using Cool Edit Pro, mixed at +3 dB sbd and -5.5 dB aud [5]
- **gd1971-12-01.sbd-set2.miller.32304.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Reel Master -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [2]
